name: wpai-cli
description: Minimal TypeScript CLI & MCP server wrapping @wp-playground/cli for WordPress project scaffolding, Blueprint validation, verification, production export, and capability discovery.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => fs.chmodSync('dist/cli.js', 0o755))"
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test dist-test/test/unit.test.js
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test dist-test/test/integration.test.js
